Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma
Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  22.05.2023 C482 No. 993 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. K.K. Jha, Advocate, along with Mr. Ravi Bisht, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mr. Tumul Nainwal, Brief Holder, for the State.

As per the FIR on which the present applicants have been summoned after registration of Criminal Case No. 1176 of 2023, State Vs. Krishan Kumar and others is on the basis of the alleged involvement of applicant No. 1 in commission of offence under Sections 313, 376(2)(n), 384, 506,
509 & 34 of IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The physical interaction which has taken place between the complainant and the applicant No. 1 herein, is admittedly shown to have been committed at difference places, for example; Neem Karoli,
Chandigarh, Ambala, Rishikesh, Hisar and Delhi.
This consistent establishment of physical relationship and a consistent social interaction prior to it itself shows that there was a consensual relationship between the complainant and the present applicant No.

entities.text: State Vs. Krishan Kumar and others

sentences.text: Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 are represented by the learned Government Advocate.
Steps to serve respondent No. 3 would be taken by the applicant within a period of 10 days from today.
Respondents may file their counter affidavits within a period of three weeks.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1176 of 2023, State Vs. Krishan Kumar and others, pending consideration before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nainital,
would be kept in abeyance.
